output.note: The 25 EUR general fee and the 10 EUR under-25 fee are treated as a rule plus an exception, not as a contradiction. The retired 20 EUR fee claim is not current, so it is not checked against the current claims. D1 is split across two claims: the deposit amount and the refund.

nodes.mission: Provide library membership and tool collection in accordance with the stated membership and opening-hours rules.
nodes.proposal_rationale: The supplied rules establish library membership and tool collection as the shared purpose served by these requirements.
The supplied claim directly specifies Saturday opening hours.
nodes.statement: The library's Saturday opening hours must be 10:00 to 14:00.

nodes.proposal_rationale: This rule governs when the tool-collection service may be used, rather than how the solution may be implemented.
nodes.statement: Tool collection must be permitted only during library opening hours.

nodes.proposal_rationale: The general annual fee and the explicitly age-specific fee together define the membership fee schedule.
nodes.statement: The annual membership fee must be EUR 25, except for members under 25, whose annual fee must be EUR 10.

nodes.proposal_rationale: The supplied minimum-age claim establishes a membership eligibility requirement.
nodes.statement: Members must be at least 18 years old.

nodes.proposal_rationale: The supplied claim explicitly requires proof of address when joining.
nodes.statement: Joining the library must require proof of address.
